plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. It provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or centered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancing two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it; clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.

## Data and refresh

The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the management API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently. The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seconds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.

- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and relative reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matching the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, responsive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and search box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only allowlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authentication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing values display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's requests, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts accounts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upstream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.

## Account details

Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the list. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache for 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redirects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background history polling is added.

The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/account-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day averages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fields stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.

## Installation and plugin configuration

Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in the plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profile; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the credential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not automatically overwrite changes from another window.

Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, uninstall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; connection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace the old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just swap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process environment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disables the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting plaintext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.
- `primaryAccounts`: select multiple accounts from a checkbox list loaded automatically from the unfiltered Host cache. Refresh Accounts fetches upstream data using the saved connection (10-second cooldown). Missing selected accounts are retained; failures never clear selections. Internally stored as exact names, empty by default. Primary cards show a badge.
- `primaryFirst`: defaults to true; places primary accounts before the selected secondary ordering.
- `displayFilter`: `all`, `primary`, `available`, or `attention`. Attention includes unavailable accounts, failed usage/statistics requests, and usage at or above 80%.
- `sortBy`: `available` (default), `name`, `usage-desc`, or `usage-asc`. Usage sorting compares the highest known usage percentage across windows; unknown values sort last. Filtering does not change upstream collection. Settings persist in the profile and are applied to subsequent cache reads. The title-bar count reflects the filtered set; the web dashboard remains independent.

Only the Host resolves the key, once per request, so rotation takes effect on the next refresh without a restart. It is never injected into the Client module, usage endpoint, or profile. The credentials file is plaintext with owner-only permissions; it is not disk encryption.

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKeyEnv": "SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

Set `allowInsecureHttp` to `true` only after explicitly accepting plaintext transport risks. To rotate the key, enter a new one in the form, or update the credential through the DSH credentials service; no reinstallation is needed.

Upgrading from 0.1.x: the plaintext `adminApiKey` field has been removed. Move its value into the credentials service under `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY` (or re-enter it in the form), then delete `adminApiKey` from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The old standalone JSON configuration and `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` environment variable are no longer read. Delete the old configuration file after migration, keeping plugin configuration as the single authority.

Upstream redirects are rejected to prevent key leakage. The frontend receives only allowlisted display fields, excluding credentials, extra, notes, and raw errors.

The local `/sub2api-monitor/api` accepts only loopback requests, a valid local Host, a same-origin Origin when present, and the custom header `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`. CORS is not enabled. Remote browsers and cross-machine connections are not currently supported.

## Installation and verification

The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there is no generation step. The Client is J

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 / skill：在 Boss 直聘求职者侧逐条浏览岗位，为每条 JD 生成只属于它的自我介绍并发给 HR —— 可见浏览器 + CDP 状态机 + 文案护栏，引擎零第三方依赖
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bossintroduce

> npm 包名与仓库名都是 `dsh-bossintroduce`，在 dsh 的插件页输入包名即可安装。
> 同一个仓库也是一份 skill：根目录有 `SKILL.md`，`scripts/` 是零第三方依赖的引擎，
> 拷进 `~/.workbuddy/skills/` 就能用，两种形态共用同一套代码。

在 Boss 直聘（**求职者侧**）替你在一个**可见的浏览器**里翻岗位，为每一条 JD 写一段
只属于它的自我介绍，发给那位 HR。

批量投递时，给每个岗位写一段"看起来是为它写的"开场话术很费神；但同一段话投所有岗位，
HR 一眼看穿，反而扣分。**这件事的全部价值在差异化** —— 同一个人，针对不同岗位点不同的名、
上不同的事实。所以这个插件做的不是"群发"，而是把**你的能力图谱**和**JD 的具体要求**
接起来，逐条产出不同的开场话术。

---

## 它怎么工作

三段式，各管一段，边界不重叠：

| 段 | 谁做 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 判断 | 模型 | 读 JD，决定投不投；决定拿哪条事实当主攻；写文案 |
| 动作 | `scripts/flow.mjs` | 查状态、点意向、读描述、翻卡片、点立即沟通、填入、发送 |
| 闸门 | `scripts/guard.py` | 文案在发出去之前必须过八项检查，退出码 0 才放行 |

状态判定与动作顺序**写死在执行器里**，运行时只查表 + 检查，不做推理 —— 模型每次重新
推导一遍"现在该点哪个按钮"，是这类自动化最不稳的地方。

```
HOME ──职位──> JOBS ──意向筛选──> 逐张读 JD ──匹配──> 立即沟通 ──> CHAT ──填入并发送──> 回 JOBS
                  ↑                                                              │
                  └──────────────────── back（自动切回意向）──────────────────────┘
```

三条约束是实测撞出来的，写进引擎而不是写进文档提醒：

- **岗位只从意向筛选列表里取。** 实测：意向列表在点过「立即沟通」后会**自行刷新**
  （已沟通的岗位移出、其余重排），而在默认推荐流里点完沟通，卡片和顺序纹丝不动 ——
  所以推荐流看起来"更稳"，但它永远给你同一批岗位。
- **一张一张看，不允许批量取列表。** 因为列表会重排，任何提前批量抓下来的清单
  （索引 / 标题 / 顺序）下一轮必然错位。
- **`back` 会落回默认推荐流**，意向筛选丢失。所以回列表这一步必须带意向标签重选，
  由执行器一步做完，不指望临场记得。

### 能力图谱：事实的唯一来源

自我介绍只能引用能力图谱里的条目，不得新增事实。图谱是一份 JSON，每人一份，抽自简历 /
公开仓库 / 自述，每条事实带 `jd_hits`（这条事实能回应哪些 JD 词）、`on_resume`
（在不在简历上）、`visibility`、`blacklist`（**不能怎么写**）。

`blacklist` 是最容易被漏、也最影响可信度的一项 —— 例："写「从零实现」，不写「自研引擎」"、
"不得写「完全独立完成」"、"不许搬业绩数字"。护栏会逐条检查，所以它不靠自觉。

### 文案护栏：不可撤回动作的最后一道闸

发出去的话收不回来，所以 `boss_say` 之前必须过 `boss_guard`。八项检查：

| 检查 | 口径 |
| --- | --- |
| 长度闸门 | 可见字符数落在预算区间（区间来自图谱 `writing_rules.budget`；不写则用引擎默认 120–200 字） |
| 禁用数字 | 白名单硬失败：只放行「有出处」的数字（日期、年份、版本号、指令集、院校背书） |
| 事实来源 | 文里至少有一个能在图谱里找到对应条目的实体 |
| 点名词 | 指定的 JD 原词确实出现在文里 |
| 主攻事实 | 声明的主攻事确实落在文里（私有仓库直接拒） |
| 未上简历项 | 引用了不在简历上的项目时，必须带上它**自己的**链接 |
| 黑名单 | 条目级 + 全局黑名单均未被触犯 |
| 可验证入口 | 文案里带公开主页（最强可验证信号） |

「默认零数字」值得单独说：提速倍数、测试条数、吞吐量、百分比这类**业绩数字一律不写**。
它们对 HR 的边际价值接近零，而且一眼就能看出是从一份通用材料里搬来的。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 装（推荐）

dsh 桌面应用 → 插件页 → 添加插件 → 填 `dsh-bossintroduce` → 重启。

管理器做的事：`pnpm add dsh-bossintroduce` → 把它加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` →
包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 作为 **bundle 层自动生效**，用户不用手写任何配置。

**这个形态下插件不需要自带 `node_modules`** —— `@deepseek-ai/*` 那类 peer 由宿主自己解析。

### 方式二：绝对路径挂载（本地开发，改代码即生效）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RaganaBloodedge/dsh-bossintroduce.git
cd dsh-bossintroduce
npm install                                   # 顺带跑 prepare（即 tsc），产出 dist/

cp cordis.example.yml cordis.local.yml        # 把里面的 <本仓库的绝对路径> 换成真实路径
dsh --profile web --patch "<cordis.local.yml 的绝对路径>" --dump-config   # 只组合配置
dsh --profile web --patch "<cordis.local.yml 的绝对路径>"                 # 真启动
```

用绝对路径挂载时入口文件在 `node_modules` 之外，Node 找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*`，
所以必须先 `npm install`。

### 方式三：当 skill 用（WorkBuddy / 其它读 SKILL.md 的宿主）

把仓库整个拷到 `~/.workbuddy/skills/dsh-bossintroduce/`，然后照根目录的 `SKILL.md` 走。
这条路径不用 Node 依赖，只用 `scripts/` 里的引擎。

### 前置要求

| 需要 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Edge 或 Chrome | 插件会起一个**可见**的浏览器并开 CDP 调试端口；用 `browserPath` 指定绝对路径，留空自动发现 |
| Python 3 | 只有文案护栏需要；用 `pythonPath` 指定，留空自动发现 |
| Node ≥ 22.6 | 本地挂载/开发时需要；桌面应用内由宿主提供（Electron 下插件自动带 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，不需要另装） |

---

## 首次使用：初始化

```bash
node scripts/init.mjs              # 建数据目录 + 落「空图谱 + 投递配置」模板
node scripts/init.mjs --migrate    # 旧版把数据放在仓库目录里 → 迁到用户目录
node scripts/flow.mjs where        # 看引擎/数据/图谱/profile 到底解析到哪
```

然后**建能力图谱**（这一步必须由模型驱动，见 `references/01-能力图谱.md` 的八步）：
从简历 PDF / 公开仓库 / 自述里抽身份、教育、荣誉、经历、项目，逐条打 `jd_hits`、分档、
标 `on_resume`/`visibility`、写黑名单。做完把关键条目念给用户逐项确认 ——
图谱里每条事实都会变成发给 HR 的一句话。

投递配置写在数据目录的 `profile.md` 里：城市、意向标签、薪资左边界、学历门槛、
毕业时间窗口、循环次数 N。

---

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `boss_where` | 报告引擎/数据/图谱/profile/浏览器 profile 的解析结果（不连浏览器） |
| `boss_init` | 落初始化脚手架（可带 `migrate` 迁旧数据） |
| `boss_browser` | `status` 探 CDP 端口 / `launch` 起可见浏览器并等端口应答 |
| `boss_state` | 当前状态 + 登录判定（**每次开工第一件事**） |
| `boss_wait_login` | 停在登录页等用户登录完（仅在 `boss_state` 判出 LOGIN 后调用） |
| `boss_enter` | HOME → 岗位页 |
| `boss_pick` | 切到某个意向的岗位列表（`label` / `index` / `list`） |
| `boss_read` | 读右侧职位描述 |
| `boss_next_card` | 选下一张卡片（事件派发，不跳页） |
| `boss_contact` | 点「立即沟通」→ 聊天页 |
| `boss_say` | **填入并发送**（不可撤回）；不给 `text` 则发送框里已有的内容 |
| `boss_back` | 回岗位列表并**自动切回意向**（一定要带 label） |
| `boss_recover` | 失败态出口：回 HOME |
| `boss_guard` | 文案护栏，退出码 0 才允许发送 |

插件还会往系统提示词里加一节，说明开工顺序与红线 —— 否则模型只看到十四个孤立的工具名，
会把它当浏览器遥控器乱点。

### 一轮循环

```
boss_state → [LOGIN？让用户登录 + boss_wait_login]
boss_enter → boss_pick --label "<意向标签>" → boss_read → 硬过滤 + 匹配判断
   ├ 不匹配 → boss_next_card → boss_read → …
   └ 匹配   → 取 JD 头号要求 → 从图谱挑一条最相关的事实当主攻
              → 按图谱口径写文案（语气 + 长度，见 `references/02`）→ boss_guard（退出码 0）
              → boss_contact → boss_say → boss_back --label → 下一条
```

凑满 N 份即停，报清单：岗位 / HR / 公司 / 薪资 / 主攻事实 / 文案首句。

---

## 已知坑

都是实测踩出来的。违反了不报错，只是行为不对：

| 症状 | 原因 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 明明发成功却报「最后一条消息不是刚发的文案」 | 早期把我方消息的类名猜成了 `item-mine`，实际是 `item-myself` | 已修；气泡文本可能带「已读」尾巴，所以用前缀包含比对 |
| 刚填入就点发送，报「按钮是禁用态」 | 编辑器状态是异步同步的，填入后按钮会短暂 `disabled` | 已修：等它变可点（≤6s）再点 |
| 按坐标点发送点空，且没有任何报错 | 页面比窗口宽，按钮落在视口右边外面 | 已修：先 `scrollIntoView` 再量，不在视口内就明确报错 |
| 中文输入框里塞进去的内容被插件改写 | 用了 CDP 的 `Input.insertText` 之外的路径 | 引擎走 `innerText` 直写并**读回比对**，不一致就报错 |
| `boss_state` 在登录页误判成已登录 | 早期判据是"找不到登录入口"，而登录页上就有登录入口 | 已修：抽成纯函数 `decideLogin`，真值表回归 |
| 从 HOME 点「消息」进岗位页 | 消息页没有选中 HR，右侧没有输入框 ⇒ CHAT_FAIL | 别点消息，用 `boss_enter`；进了失败态一律 `boss_recover`，不手动补救 |
| 点卡片结果跳到了职位详情页 | 卡片 hover 会浮出「立即沟通」浮层，鼠标命中浮层 | 选卡片用事件派发，不用鼠标点 |
| 窗口最小化后什么都点不到 | 坐标点击依赖元素尺寸，最小化时尺寸为 0 | 保持窗口可见 |
| `taskkill` 之后用户得重新登录 | 那会连用户已登录的浏览器一起杀掉 | **绝不 taskkill 清场**；要停就停启动它的那个任务 |

---

## 数据在哪

**引擎与个人数据是分开的**，所以升级/分享/发布插件都不会碰到你的数据：

| | 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 引擎 | 包目录（`SKILL.md` / `scripts` / `references` / `assets` / `dist`） | 流程、执行器、护栏、模板 |
| 个人数据 | `$AI_HOME/data`（默认 `~/.auto-introduce/data`） | `capability-graph.json`、`profile.md`、`resume-raw.txt`、`drafts/` |
| 浏览器登录态 | `$AI_HOME/edge-profile` | 已登录的浏览器 profile |

解析顺序（Node 与 Python 同一套口径，见 `scripts/paths.mjs`）：
`AI_DATA_DIR` → `$AI_HOME/data` → `<包目录>/data`（旧版遗留，仅在确实存在时才用并提示迁移）。

随包发布的只有引擎。`scripts/pack.mjs` 打可分发副本时会再扫一遍**有没有夹带个人数据**
（图谱、profile、简历、浏览器缓存），有就报错退出。

---

## 自检

```bash
npm run selftest          # 引擎 + 图谱结构一起过（离线，不需要浏览器）
node scripts/flow.mjs where
```

自检在**没有个人图谱的全新环境**下也能全绿（图谱相关断言正确跳过），
所以它是"这个包收到了就能用"的最低保证。

---

## 发版（维护者）

```bash
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version    # 或 minor / major
git commit -am "chore(release): x.y.z"
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

三件容易踩的事：

- **本机默认 registry 往往是镜像**（`registry.npmmirror.com`），它只读、不能发布 —— 必须显式带
  `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`。
- **新包的第一个版本不会直接上线。** npm 2026 年起启用了暂存发布（staged publishing）：首次
  `publish` 只是把版本提交到暂存区，registry 上会出现一个 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版，真实版本要到
  npmjs.com 的 **Staged Packages** 里点 Approve 才上线（这一步需要 2FA）。**同包的后续版本直接
  上线、不再进暂存。**
- **发布凭证。** npm 现在强制「账号开着 2FA」或「一个勾了 Bypass 2FA 的 granular access token」
  才能发布 —— 关掉 2FA 反而会拿到
  `403 Two-factor authentication or granular access token with bypass 2fa enabled is required`。
  需要非交互发布时，建一个 bypass-2FA 的 granular token（Packages and scopes 给 Read and write），
  临时写进**项目内** `.npmrc`（已在 `.gitignore` 里），发完即删。

---

## License

MIT © 2026 Li Yichen (李依宸)

# dsh-maximize

DSH 插件：会话页右上角「全屏」按钮。点击后隐藏顶部标题栏（对话/轨迹 tabs）、底部输入框、左侧边栏；右侧边栏保持可打开，按钮自然落在整页最右上。再点一次或按 `ESC` 恢复原样。

按钮采用毛玻璃风（半透明白底 + 模糊背景 + 细边框），仅保留全屏/退出图标，悬停时显示「全屏 / 退出全屏」提示。中英文文案自动跟随 DSH 语言。

## 功能

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 全屏开关 | 点击右上角按钮进入/退出全屏 |
| 隐藏顶栏 | 隐藏 `header[data-window-drag]`（含对话/轨迹 tabs） |
| 隐藏输入框 | 隐藏 `[data-composer-seat]` 与轨迹页的 `[data-conversation-composer-overlay]` |
| 折叠左栏 | 走 `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`，退出时还原进入前状态 |
| 右栏不动 | 右侧边栏开着时按钮仍在整页最右上角 |
| ESC 退出 | 按 `ESC` 或再次点击按钮恢复原样 |
| 状态持久 | 同一页切换会话（overlay 槽重挂载）保持全屏态 |

## 安装

本地安装（推荐用于自建 DSH 环境）：

```bash
# 克隆仓库
git clone https://github.com/ADkun/dsh-maximize.git
cd dsh-maximize

# 在 DSH profile 目录下以 bundle 形式安装（以 web profile 为例）
dsh plugin add ./dsh-maximize
# 或通过插件管理器加载 bundle
```

安装后**刷新页面**一次，客户端模块才会注册到 `shell.overlay` 插槽并显示按钮。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-maximize/
├── client.js        # 客户端半边：React 组件注入 shell.overlay 插槽
├── index.js         # 宿主半边：空实现（纯客户端插件）
├── cordis.patch.yml # Loader patch：注册 bundle id/name
├── package.json     # 包元数据，声明 dsh.client 平台 web
└── README.md
```

## 开发注意

`client.js` 运行在 DSH ModuleLoader 工厂垫片中，**不能**使用顶层 `import ... from 'react'`（裸说明符在工厂作用域外无法解析）。必须用工厂模式获取 React：

```js
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: 'dsh-maximize',
  factory(require) {
    const React = require('react');
    const { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } = React;
    const h = React.createElement;
    // ...
  },
});
```

文案通过 `ctx.locale.register('dsh-maximize', 'zh', {...})` / `bind('dsh-maximize')` 注册，遵循 DSH 本地化规范。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete-cascade

**给 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：点会话旁的 `⋯` → 删除，连子会话一起清干净。**

npm 包名与仓库名都是 `dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

DeepSeek Harness 出于设计考虑**只提供归档，不提供删除**——会话可以隐藏，但永远不会被移除，日志会一直堆在磁盘上。这个插件把删除能力补回来，作为一个可随时卸载的 bundle，不动官方任何代码。

---

## 功能

- **侧栏菜单项**：会话行的 `⋯` 菜单里新增「删除会话」，排在「归档会话」之后
- **确认弹窗**：删之前告诉你到底会删掉什么，并**列出将被连带删除的子会话**
- **递归删除**：连同该会话的全部子代理子孙（孙代理也删），fork 会话不受影响
- **彻底清理**：对话日志、投影缓存、搜索索引、工作区记账，一处不留
- **安全护栏**：有任务在跑时拒绝删除并指明是哪个会话，不会删一半

## 安装

包已发布到 npm：**<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-delete-cascade>**

### 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness App）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入包名：

```
dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

也可以直接粘贴仓库地址 `https://github.com/Changqin1024/dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

装完**完全退出并重开 App**，侧栏会话的 `⋯` 菜单里就会出现「删除会话」。

> ⚠️ **桌面端的 profile 不能用 CLI 安装。** DSH 对 `desktop` profile 做了排他保护：
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
> 桌面端请走上面的「设置 → 插件」。

### Web / CLI profile

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

例如 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-delete-cascade`。装完重启该 profile。

从 GitHub 安装也可以（npm 之外的备选路径，会锁定到具体 commit）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Changqin1024/dsh-session-delete-cascade
```

### 卸载

桌面端：**设置 → 插件**，找到本插件点卸载。

CLI：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-delete-cascade`。

### 版本说明

`engines.dsh` 声明为 `>=0.2.0-rc.2`。本插件用到的
`ctx.connection.fetch.register` 在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证通过。

## 删除范围

在弹窗里点确认后，以下内容会被移除（针对目标会话**及其子代理血缘**）：

| 内容 | 位置 | 处理方式 |
|---|---|---|
| 对话历史 | `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/`（append-only JSONL 日志） | 逐个删除目录 |
| 投影缓存（空会话标记、最后提问时间、标题等） | `session_projcache` 存储域 | 逐行删除 |
| 搜索索引行 | 会话搜索 SQLite 索引 | 日志消失后自动对账清除（索引观测的是持久化列表） |
| 工作区记账 | 每个工作区记录的 `sessionIds`，以及全局归档集、置顶集 | 逐项移除 |

**不删的东西**：按会话 ID 无法寻址的缓存，例如附件请求图缓存（`~/.dsh/cache/attachments/request-images/`）。清它需要先读日志拿内容哈希，代价不成比例；会话删掉后它也不会再出现在任何界面，后续按需重新生成。

## 血缘规则：什么算「子会话」

**子代理**（`origin: 'subagent'`）会被递归删除，包括子代理的子代理。

**fork 不算子会话。** fork 出来的会话虽然带 `parentSession` 字段，但没有 `subagent` 来源，它是独立对话，**会保留**。这条规则跟 DSH 自带归档门禁判定会话归属的规则完全一致。

- 弹窗会预览血缘：按标题列出子会话及数量
- toast 会汇报连带删除了几个
- 删子会话只删它自己的子树，父会话和兄弟会话不动

## 执行顺序与安全

删除严格按以下顺序，保证任何中间状态都不是撕裂的：

1. **收集血缘** — 从持久化 header 读，而不是从运行时的 Subagent catalog 读。这样即使中间某个会话读不出来，血缘依然完整。
2. **拒绝检查** — 只要血缘里**任何一个**会话还有工作在跑（进行中的回合、运行中的子代理、后台任务、定时提醒），就以 `session/delete-active` 拒绝，并在详情里列出**每一个**出问题的会话 ID 和它的活动类型。拒绝时不会删除任何东西。
3. **释放 Agent** — 深度优先（先子后父）。子会话的 loop 先排空，父会话的日志才会消失，避免迟到的结算打到已经不存在的父级。
4. 清**投影缓存**行
5. 删**日志目录**
6. 从**工作区记账**中移除

第 3～6 步都是**容错**的（失败只记日志、不抛错），避免某个派生存储卡死导致日志残留——日志才是侧栏会一直显示的那个东西。

## 实现说明

插件分 Host / Client 两半，通过 **Connection 上的 HTTP 路由**通信：

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半边：注册 `POST /api/session-delete.delete`，血缘遍历与有序删除 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：菜单行、带血缘预览的确认弹窗、结果提示（控件全部内联，无 Harness 包依赖） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入唯一一条 Host 插件行 |
| `package.json` | bundle 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` + web 端 `dsh.client` 配置 |
| `icon.svg`、`locale/*.json` | 插件管理页卡片元数据 |

## 验证清单

1. 侧栏悬停任一有内容的会话行，打开 `⋯` 菜单：**删除会话**是最后一项
2. 在一个有子代理的会话上点它：弹窗会写明保留边界，并列出将一并删除的子会话
3. 确认后：血缘里每一行都从侧栏消失，对应的 `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/` 目录都不在了
4. 同一父会话 fork 出来的会话仍在侧栏
5. 侧栏搜索只存在于已删会话里的文字：无结果

## 已知边界

- 附件请求图缓存不清理，理由见上
- 血缘按持久化 header 遍历，因此**只覆盖已经落盘的会话**；纯内存中尚未 materialize 的子会话若不在 `session.list()` 里，不会被遍历到（实际使用中子会话总是先落盘）
- 删除是"整条血缘全或无"：任何一个后代在跑，整条都删不了。这是刻意的，半删会留下指向不存在父级的孤儿
- 客户端界面控件是内联实现而非复用宿主组件库。若 DSH 未来改动这些控件的视觉规范，插件需要跟进；代价换来的是不受宿主包变动影响

## 许可

MIT

## 相关

- DeepSeek Harness：https://www.deepseek.com/harness/
- 本插件未修改 DSH 任何文件，仅通过官方插件机制接入

# dsh-sidechat

[English](README_EN.md) · 中文

DSH 侧边聊天插件：从主会话 fork 独立侧聊，划选引用并添加注释，将结论回流到主会话。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkisok0123/dsh-sidechat
```

本仓库包含源码和预编译的 `lib/`，GitHub 安装无需在用户机器上编译。安装后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新窗口。

如果已经安装 `dsh-sidenote`，请先移除旧插件，再安装本插件，避免重复入口：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sidenote
```

进入已有回复的会话，点击顶栏「侧边」，或在输入框使用 `/side`，打开右侧栏中的插件面板。

## 功能

- 独立侧聊继承主会话完整历史，主线与侧聊分别运行。
- 侧聊语义与 Codex `/side` 对齐：首条消息注入边界协议块（继承历史仅作参照、侧聊是独立助手：默认非改写、不碰子代理、不主动请求越权），面板以「侧边会话边界」卡呈现。
- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上复用宿主原生 Conversation Factory，包括消息、工具、模型、权限及输入框；旧宿主使用插件自绘面板。
- 模型菜单刷新并显示提供方，切换模型后恢复输入焦点。
- 划选 assistant 正文：「添加到对话」保留可选注解编辑器；「在侧边聊天中提问」直接打开/聚焦侧聊、加入选中文字引用并聚焦输入框，不弹注解框、不覆盖草稿、不自动发送。打开失败时保留选中文字，可重试或取消。
- 临时侧聊在当前浏览器的会话列表中隐藏，可重开；保存为正式会话时创建可见副本。
- 侧聊结论可作为引用回流到主会话。

下面是右侧栏布局示例。实际消息与输入框样式随宿主版本、主题和原生渲染模式变化；它不是宿主自带的浮动侧边对话窗口。

![右侧栏布局示例](docs/assets/04-side-chat-panel.png)

## 兼容性

当前包保留原插件的引擎声明，使用 Node.js 20 及以上。原生会话渲染针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 实现；引擎范围不代表所有组合都已验证。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check:arch
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm check:package
```

修改源码后，将对应 `lib/` 一并提交。CI 重建并检查构建产物与已提交版本一致，以保持 GitHub 直接安装可用。

## 来源与许可

本插件基于 [gyixuan 的 dsh-sidenote](https://github.com/g-yixuan/dsh-sidenote) 改进。感谢原作者提供侧边聊天、划选注释及回流能力的基础实现。本项目不是从零原创，也不是上游官方发行版。

本分支主要改进了宿主原生会话渲染、侧聊边界协议、划选后直接在侧聊提问、模型切换与输入焦点恢复，以及 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 兼容性。具体功能和限制见上文。

保留原作者 `Copyright (c) 2026 gyixuan` 与完整 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)。本仓库从独立源码快照建立，未继承原 Git 提交历史；后续改进由本仓库维护者负责。

plugins.description: DSH 人设卡插件：按会话绑定的人设卡片与全局提示词段落，支持导入 .md 人设文件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-persona-cards —— 人设卡 在 **设置 → 人设卡** 里管理人设，在**每个会话**里选用哪一套。选中的那张会拼进 系统提示词，排在官方部署人设之后、所有工具说明之前。**改完下一个模型步骤就生效，不用重启。** **默认不注入任何人设** —— 要用哪张，得在会话里显式选。 另有一段**全局设置**：不挑会话、不挑人设，写了就永远注入（排在人设之前）。 见下面「全局设置」一节。 --- ## 功能 - **设置里的独立一页**：左侧设置导航新增「人设卡」，与「通用」「模型」「插件」并列。 - **全局设置**（与人设卡并列的一块）：一段对所有会话都成立的附加正文， **不管会话有没有选人设都会注入**，且排在人设之前；留空即不注入。见下面专节。 - **多张卡**：新建 / 编辑 / 删除，每张卡有名字、正文、启用开关。 - **卡片态 / 编辑态分离**：列表默认是只读卡片（标题 + 正文预览 + 开关）， 点「编辑」才展开输入框，点「完成」回到卡片态、点「取消」直接丢弃草稿。 - **会话级选择**：会话输入框左侧有个「人设」选择器。选中只作用于**当前会话**， 别的会话不受影响；不选就是「不使用人设」。 - **自动保存**：编辑完成时立即落盘；开关 / 删除 / 新建立即落盘；全局设置为 700ms 防抖落盘。 - **零污染**：没选人设、全局设置也留空时，插件对那个会话的提示词**完全不存在** （空段落会被 DSH 自动丢弃）。 ### 全局设置：唯一一段"无条件的"注入 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | 在哪写 | 设置 → 人设卡 → 页面顶部「全局设置」框 | | 何时注入 | **永远** —— 不挑会话、不挑人设、不挑启用状态 | | 注入位置 | 官方部署人设(0) **之后**、选中的人设卡(100) **之前** → `order = 90` | | 段落名 | `persona-cards:global` | | 存哪 | `settings.json`（与人设卡 `cards.json` 分开） | | 空值语义 | 全空白 = 没写 = 整段被 DSH 丢弃，插件对这个会话不产生任何提示词 | 排序上刻意取 90：它是官方 `SECTION_ORDERS` 里 `DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX(0)` 与 本插件人设段 `(100)` 之间的空位，不会和任何官方段撞号。语义是「全局总纲 → 具体身份」： 对所有会话一致的要求先立，会话选的人设后置覆盖。 **为什么单独一段，而不是拼进人设段**：两段的生效条件完全不同（人设段"没选就空"、 全局段"写了就在"）。合成一段就得在渲染时拼字符串，还要额外处理"只有全局没有人设" 的边界；分开之后 DSH 的 `renderPrompt()` 空段丢弃规则天然把两种情况都处理干净。 **为什么单独一个文件**：卡片与全局设置的自动保存是各自独立触发的，共用一个文件 就意味着每次落盘都写全量，一边的写入会把另一边刚改的内容按旧值覆盖回去。 分开之后两个文件各自「临时文件 + rename」，互不干扰。 `{{model}}` / `{{cwd}}` / `{{provider}}` 的引用规则**与人设完全一致**：落盘前过同一道 白名单闸门（`normalizeBody()`），其余引用一律拒绝保存并说明原因。 ### 语义：设置页管仓库，会话管这次用哪张 | 层 | 存哪 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | 卡片 | `cards.json` | 设置页维护 | | 启用开关 | 同上 | **只决定这张卡进不进备选池**，不替任何会话做决定 | | 会话 → 卡片 绑定 | `session-cards.json` | 会话界面的选择器写入 | | 全局设置 | `settings.json` | 设置页维护，**无条件注入**，与会话/人设无关 | | 注入什么 | —— | **全局设置（若有）+「绑了就用绑的那张；没绑就什么都不注入」** | 这个设计解决了一个实际问题：把几张卡全启用，新会话**不会**把几个人格叠加成 互相打架的身份指令 —— 因为「启用」不等于「生效」。 会话 id 来自段落 text 函数收到的组装上下文 —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` 的 `assembleContextFor()` 返回的是 `{ agent, scope: agent, signal? }`， 所以 `context.agent.id` 就是当前会话。拿不到 agent（或绑的卡被停用/清空/删除）时 一律按「不注入」处理，不会抛错、也不会误注入别的卡。 ### ⚠️ 为什么选择器不在「新建会话」界面 试过了，**DSH 的插槽体系里没有干净的位置**： 1. 新建会话的空状态（hero）里，所有会话级控件都被官方显式跳过 —— `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 里写死了 `input === undefined || sessionId === undefined ? null : renderSlot("conversation.input.left", {})`。 新建会话时还没有 `sessionId`，所以这些槽一律不渲染。 2. hero 区唯一能挂东西的是 `conversation.hero.agentPreset`，但它是 **single 槽且已被官方占用** （`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`）—— 用它就得顶掉官方的 agent 预设选择器。 所以选择器放在 **composer 工具行左侧**（`conversation.input.left`，list 槽、空着、`replaceRisk: none`）。 效果是：**发出第一条消息后选择器出现**，之后随时可切；新会话的第一条消息用设置里的默认规则。 ## 安装 包已链接进 desktop profile。手工装的三步（本机开发用）： 1. 包目录 junction 到 `/node_modules/dsh-persona-cards` 2. `/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-persona-cards": "0.2.0"` 3. `/cordis.patch.yml` 追加 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert 块 官方装法：`dsh plugin --profile

add dsh-persona-cards` ### ⚠️ 改完 Host 代码必须**完全重启** DSH DSH 的 Loader 复用 ESM 模块缓存：禁用/启用插件、改配置文件、新建会话都不会 重新 import `lib/index.js`。 **两半的更新方式不一样，会错配**： | 半边 | 什么时候重新读盘 | |---|---| | `lib/client.js` | `dsh-client-modules` 对这个文件挂了 watch —— 改完**刷新页面**就是新的 | | `lib/index.js` | **只在 DSH 进程启动时**加载一次 | 所以「刷新页面」之后很容易出现**界面是新的、Host 是旧的**：新界面按新协议调 `saveGlobal`，旧 Host 的 switch 里没有这个 case，回一句 `未知接口：saveGlobal`，界面上就是「保存失败：未知接口：saveGlobal」。 现在这种错配会被显式认出来（快照里没有 `global` 字段 = Host 是旧版本）， 设置页直接给出警告并禁用输入框，不会再让人对着"能打字却存不下去"猜。 **修法只有一个：完全退出 DSH 再重新打开**。 ## 数据 | 项 | 位置 | |---|---| | 卡片文件 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/cards.json` | | 全局设置 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/settings.json` | | 会话绑定 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/session-cards.json` | | 诊断输出 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/diag.json`（排查注册问题用，可删） | `$DSH_HOME` 解析顺序：环境变量 `DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh`。 默认即 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\persona-cards\cards.json`。**同目录下已有的 `.md` 人设文件不会被读写或修改。** ## 注入位置 两个提示词段落，`order` 取自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` 的 `SECTION_ORDERS`： ``` HARNESS_IDENTITY(-1000) → DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX(0) → ★persona-cards:global(90) → ★persona-cards:user(100) → PLAN_POLICY(500) → TEAM_POLICY(600) → 各工具说明(1000+) ``` | 段落名 | order | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `persona-cards:global` | 90 | 全局设置，非空就注入，与上下文无关 | | `persona-cards:user` | 100 | 当前会话选中的那张人设卡，没选就是空串（整段被丢弃） | ## DSH 0.2.0 兼容性（重要） DSH 从 `0.1.7-rc.2` 升到 `0.2.0-rc.1` 后，cordis 收紧了 ctx 代理： **没声明 `inject` 的服务属性访问会直接抛错** —— `cannot get property "X" without inject`（`cordis/lib/index.js` 的 `ReflectService.handler.get`）。 `connection.rpc.handle()` 内部是 `register(owner = this.ctx, …)` → `owner.webServer.register(route)`，而 `this.ctx` 解析成**调用方 fiber 的 ctx** （官方注释明写："channel registrations belong to the caller fiber"）。 本插件刻意不声明 inject（声明会把 apply 推迟，见 `whenService` 注释）， 于是官方通道整条挂掉，表现就是设置页报： ``` 读取失败：transport failure for /persona-cards/state: HTTP 405 ``` （405 = 请求落到了 fallback，说明路由压根没注册。） **修法：官方通道优先，失败自动降级。** 降级路径用 `ctx.get('webServer')` —— 官方给的服务可选访问形式，**不受 inject 约束** —— 自己挂 `{kind:'prefix'}` 路由，信任校验复用 `connection.admit(req)`： 它是实例方法，只读 `trustedHosts` / `browserAuth` / `operator` 三个实例属性， 完全不碰 ctx。 **已在真实运行环境实测过**（建了个独立探针包，新包名没有 ESM 缓存所以当场加载）： | 检查项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `ctx.get('webServer')` | `object` | | `webServer.register` | `function` | | `ctx.get('connection')` / `.admit` | `object` / `function` | | 路由注册 | 成功 | | 未认证请求打到该路由 | **401**（不是 404/405），且确实进了处理器 | 401 是预期的：命令行的裸请求没有浏览器认证 cookie，被信任栅栏拦下； 页面内发起的同源请求会带 cookie，正常通过。 ## 两个保命设计（别改） 1. **`{{...}}` 闸门**。DSH 的 `renderPrompt()` 会对每个段落做变量插值，而 `interpolate()` 在三种情况下**直接抛异常**：引用了没注册的名字 （`unknown prompt variable`）、引用了已注册但本次组装没有值的变量、以及写法 不合法（`malformed prompt variable reference`）。用户在人设里顺手写个 `{{随手写的}}` 就能把整个会话搞崩。 做法是**开启插值 + 落盘前白名单校验**： - **开启插值**，让 DSH 官方注册的变量真正替换成当前值； - **保存时**用 `scanVariableReferences()` 扫正文（顺序逐字复刻官方 `interpolate()`，包括「没有配对的单个 `{{` 当普通文本放行」这条）， 只放行 `{{model}}` / `{{cwd}}` / `{{provider}}`，其余引用拒绝保存并说明原因。 全库扫过 DSH 的 289 个包：官方一共只注册了这三个变量（都在 `dsh-agent-loop`， 取值形如 `context.agent?.options.model`），而且官方自己**没有任何内置段落** 引用它们 —— 这三个就是留给插件/组合层用的。 2. **不能用 `deployment:persona-prefix` 这个段名**。它归 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 所有，而官方注释明写那个插件是 scope-only 的： 全局挂载会与注册表自身的注册相撞并 fail loud。所以本插件用自己的段名。 ## 实现要点 ``` dsh-persona-cards/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（平台 web） ├── cordis.patch.yml # 挂载声明 └── lib/ ├── index.js # Host：持久化（卡片 / 绑定 / 全局设置）+ 两个提示词段落 + RPC 通道 └── client.js # Client：设置页 UI + 会话界面的人设选择器 ``` **Host ↔ Client 通信**走 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler)`。 通道内部已经过 `admit(req)`（Host/Origin 信任栅栏 + 浏览器鉴权），被拒即 401/403 —— 所以本插件**不需要**自己写路由守卫，这也是没走 `ctx.webServer.register()` 野路子的原因。 客户端侧对应 `ctx.connection.rpc.call(channel, endpoint, payload)`， 返回 `{ok:true,value}` / `{ok:false,error}`，**业务失败不抛异常**，必须自己解包。 **service 获取刻意不用依赖注入**：`apply` 用 `whenService()` 轮询取 `systemPrompt` / `connection`。本机实测踩过一次 `ctx.inject([...], cb)` 静默挂起（fiber 显示 active，但回调始终没跑，RPC 通道就这么没了）。 **`dsh.client.inject` 填的是包名，不是 cordis 服务名**（`package.json` 里）： ```json "client": { "platform": "web", "inject": [ "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection" ] } ``` 它是**客户端插件之间的加载顺序依赖**，让提供方先于消费方加载；cordis 服务依赖 写在 `client.js` 的 `exports.inject` 里（`['slots','locale','connection']`）。 这里一开始写成了服务名，虽然被宽容处理也能跑，但不合规范 —— 对齐参照物是官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general`（同样注册独立设置页，用的正是这三个包）。 **这个声明只在客户端启动时解析一次**：改完它必须重启客户端，改 `client.js` 都不够。 ## 已知限制 - 正文上限 100000 字符、单卡名 100 字符、最多 50 张卡；超限**拒绝保存**并给出原因， 不做静默截断。全局设置共用这个正文上限。 - 卡片是全局的，不分会话/工作区；全局设置同样只有一段，不能按会话覆盖 （要按会话区分就用人设卡）。 - 没有排序、导入导出、md 文件导入。

plugins.description: Route DeepSeek Harness web_search/web_fetch through DeepSeek's native tools APIs (POST /v1/tools/search, /v1/tools/fetch) via a small Rust engine.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-tools-deepseek

**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

[![engine](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/actions/workflows/engine.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/actions/workflows/engine.yml)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)

A provider bundle for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (**DSH**) `ctx.web` seam. It routes `web_search` and `web_fetch` to DeepSeek's own **native Search and Fetch APIs** instead of the model-backed web-search tool, and falls back to the native provider when the tools API fails or returns nothing.

The HTTP work lives in a small **Rust engine** (`crates/engine`, ~900 KiB) spoken to over NDJSON on stdio; the cordis plugin is a thin JavaScript bridge around it.

```text
tool-web ──▶ ctx.web ──▶ this bundle ──┬─▶ WebSearchProvider ─┐
                                       └─▶ WebFetchProvider  ─┤ NDJSON/stdio
                                                              ▼
                                          dsh-web-tools-deepseek(.exe)   (Rust)
                                                              │
                                        POST /v1/tools/search │ POST /v1/tools/fetch
                                                              ▼
                                                    https://api.deepseek.com
```

---

## Why — and what it costs

DSH ships two web providers by default:

| | provider | how it works | billed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| search | `deepseek-official` | a **server-side tool** (`web_search_20250305`) run inside the model call | **tokens** — the results land in your context |
| fetch | `http` | fetches the URL locally, anonymously | free |

This bundle replaces both with DeepSeek's dedicated endpoints:

| | endpoint | billed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| search | `POST /v1/tools/search` | **¥5 per 1,000 successful requests** (≈ ¥0.005 each) |
| fetch | `POST /v1/tools/fetch` | **¥5 per 1,000 successful requests** (≈ ¥0.005 each) |

> **Only successful requests are billed.** A request counts when it returns HTTP 200 *and* produced a result — for search a non-empty `results`, for fetch page content. A 403, a 404, an empty result set, a timeout and a failed call are all **free**. `count` changes how many results you get, never the price. See [Pricing and limits](#pricing-and-limits).

The trade: **a predictable per-call price instead of token cost**, plus search results that arrive as clean structured fields (`title` / `url` / `summary` / `date`) rather than as text the model has to parse out of its own tool output. To go back, see [Rolling back](#rolling-back).

---

## Install

### From a clone or directory

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-tools-deepseek"
```

### From GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek"
```

### What the install does

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding it appends to `dsh.profile.bundles` and its [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml) is applied. That patch:

1. **inserts** the plugin row (registering `deepseek-tools-api` for both search and fetch), and
2. **overrides the `web` row** so `searchProvider` and `fetchProvider` point at it.

Both halves are required. A patch entry **replaces that row's whole `config`** rather than deep-merging it, so the override must restate *both* keys; and because three providers are then registered (`deepseek-official`, `http`, `deepseek-tools-api`) the seam would otherwise refuse to guess and raise `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`.

**Restart DSH after installing.** Cordis re-runs `apply()` on a config reload, but the plugin *module* is ESM-cached — code edits and a first mount need a process restart (verified experimentally; see [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)).

### Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` 0.2.x (targets the `ctx.web` provider seam) |
| Node | ≥ 18.17 |
| Credential | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, or a literal `apiKey` |
| Rust | **not needed** — `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-win32-x64.exe` is committed. Build it for Linux/macOS, or take a [release asset](https://github.com/CarbonAnime/dsh-web-tools-deepseek/releases/latest) (zip uploads do not keep the executable bit: `chmod +x` it). |

### Building the engine

```bash
cargo build --release          # or: npm run build:engine
node scripts/stage-engine.mjs  # → bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-<platform>-<arch>
```

The engine is resolved in this order, so a source checkout, an installed copy and a packed tarball all work:

1. `$DSH_WEB_TOOLS_DEEPSEEK_BIN`
2. the `enginePath` config field
3. `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek-<platform>-<arch>[.exe]`
4. `bin/dsh-web-tools-deepseek[.exe]`
5. `target/release/…`, then `target/debug/…` (an unstaged checkout)

---

## Configuration

Every field has a working default, so an empty config block is valid. Override fields on the plugin row in a `cordis.patch.yml` at or after this bundle:

```yaml
- id: web-tools-deepseek
  name: dsh-web-tools-deepseek
  config:
    count: 8
    qps: 4
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | `''` | Literal API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` — a literal ends up in the config file. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Credential reference, resolved through the `credentials` service **on every call**, so a rotated key is picked up without a restart. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | API origin. |
| `searchProviderId` | `deepseek-tools-api` | Id the search provider registers under; must match `web.searchProvider`. |
| `fetchProviderId` | `deepseek-tools-api` | Id the fetch provider registers under; must match `web.fetchProvider`. |
| `count` | `10` | Results requested when the caller passes no `maxResults` (1–50). Price-neutral. |
| `snippetSource` | `summary` | Which API field becomes each source's `snippet`: `summary` (600–800 chars, *"for models to read"*) or `snippet` (100–200 chars, *"for front-end display"*). See below. |
| `oriQuestion` | `''` | Sent as `ori_question` when non-empty; over 128 characters is truncated with a warning. |
| `localization` | `''` | Sent as `localization` when non-empty. This is an **IP address** used to prefer results local to it — *not* a language tag. For language, put `lang:zh,en` in the query. |
| `blockedAsResult` | `true` | Return fetch 403/404 as a *result* carrying a clear non-content notice (`true`), instead of throwing (`false`). |
| `includeTitle` | `true` | Prepend the API's `title` as an H1 when the Markdown does not already carry it. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt deadline; `0` disables it. |
| `retries` | `1` | Extra attempts for `408` / `429` / `5xx` **and transport failures** (DNS, TLS, socket). |
| `qps` | `5` | Per-endpoint rate limit. Search and fetch are limited independently. |
| `userAgent` | `dsh-web-tools-deepseek/<version>` | `User-Agent` header. |
| `fallbackSearchProviderId` | `deepseek-official` | Another **already registered** provider to retry on when the tools API fails or returns nothing. Empty string disables the fallback. |
| `fallbackOn` | `both` | When the fallback runs: `never`, `error`, `empty`, or `both`. |
| `enginePath` | `''` | Explicit engine binary path; overrides the `bin/` lookup. |
| `diag` | `true` | Append one JSON line per HTTP attempt to the diagnostics log. |

### Why `snippetSource` defaults to `summary`

DeepSeek's documentation labels the two fields by consumer:

> `snippet` — short summary, relevant to the query, usually 100–200 characters, **suitable for front-end display**.

The only consumer of a DSH `WebSource` is a model, so `summary` is the faithful default even though it costs several times the context (8 results ≈ 5K characters ≈ 2K tokens). Set `snippetSource: snippet` to spend less.

# dsh-ios-simulator-helper

[English](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper/blob/main/README.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://github.com/zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper/blob/main/LICENSE)
![platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS-lightgrey.svg)
[![target: DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-blue.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `ios-simulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 20 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a full **settings page** (Settings → iOS Simulator) that edits the simulator parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for the `ios_simulator` MCP server keep working; one tool is added — `ios_shutdown_simulator`, because the original could boot a simulator but never stop one.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; an empty field falls back to the original plugin's `IOS_SIM_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The settings page detects the host system and, **on a non-macOS host, states that this plugin only supports macOS**; every `ios_*` tool refuses in one clear sentence instead of failing with `spawn xcrun ENOENT`.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper`, and the plugin page shows the name from `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json` — **iOS Simulator** / **iOS 模拟器** — rather than the raw package name.

## Quick start

On a Mac with full Xcode, at least one iOS runtime and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
   ```

   In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Settings → iOS Simulator** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `ios_preflight` runs (full Xcode, a simulator runtime, `idb`), and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the iPhone 16 simulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 21 `ios_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that settings page.

## Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Settings page](#settings-page)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Skill and slash command](#skill-and-slash-command)
- [Differences from the original](#differences-from-the-original)
- [Architecture](#architecture)
- [Development and verification](#development-and-verification)
- [Releases and versioning](#releases-and-versioning)
- [Marketplace listing](#marketplace-listing)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| macOS | The only supported host. `xcrun simctl`, `xcodebuild` and Simulator.app exist nowhere else. |
| Full Xcode | `xcode-select -p` must point at `Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`; Command Line Tools alone are not enough. |
| An iOS Simulator runtime | At least one iOS/iPadOS runtime installed from Xcode → Settings → Platforms. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |
| `idb` (optional) | Needed only by the `ios_ui_*` tools. Without it, build/run/screenshot/logs are unaffected. |

`ios_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the settings page's "Run diagnostic" button runs the same checks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved.

`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so DSH's reconcile step appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles`, profile boot merges `cordis.patch.yml`, and exactly one host row is mounted. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness: the plugin declares the versions it is built against instead of pulling in a second copy, and it has no runtime dependencies of its own. DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

### Open the settings page

After a reload or restart, open **Settings → iOS Simulator**. The page only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace; otherwise it leaves no trace.

### Upgrade and uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/ios-simulator-helper`) holds screenshots, build logs and DerivedData; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

## Settings page

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `ios-simulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The page reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness.

| Group | Field | Type | Default | Legacy env fallback | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Simulator and device | `defaultDevice` | text (suggestions from this machine) | `iPhone 16` | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_DEVICE` | Device-name fragment used when a tool names no `udid`/`device`; falls back to the first available iPhone on a miss. |
| | `defaultRuntime` | text (suggestions from installed runtimes) | empty | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_RUNTIME` | Runtime fragment such as `iOS-27`; empty matches any. A **preference, not a requirement**: a stale value widens the pool instead of erroring. |
| | `autoBootSimulator` | switch | on | `IOS_SIM_AUTO_BOOT` | When off, tools fail instead of running `simctl boot` for a stopped target. |
| | `autoOpenSimulator` | switch | on | `IOS_SIM_AUTO_OPEN` | Matches the original by opening the Simulator window (boot / show / open URL / build and run); off keeps everything headless. |
| | `bootTimeoutMs` | integer | `120000` | `IOS_SIM_BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS` | Longest wait for one `simctl boot` / `bootstatus`. |
| UI automation | `uiBackend` | select | `auto` | `IOS_SIM_UI_BACKEND` | `auto` probes for `idb`; `idb` requires it; `none` disables the UI tools; `xcodebuildmcp` is reserved. |
| | `idbBinary` | text | `idb` | `IOS_SIM_IDB_BINARY` | Command name or absolute path of `idb`. |
| | `uiTimeoutMs` | integer | `60000` | `IOS_SIM_UI_TIMEOUT_MS` | Longest runtime of one `idb` UI command. |
| Build and DerivedData | `defaultConfiguration` | text | `Debug` | `IOS_SIM_CONFIGURATION` | Used when a tool names no `configuration`. |
| | `buildTimeoutMs` | integer | `600000` | `IOS_SIM_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS` | Longest runtime of one `xcodebuild build`. |
| | `extraBuildArgs` | multiline | empty | `IOS_SIM_EXTRA_BUILD_ARGS` | One argument per line, `#` starts a comment; inserted after `-derivedDataPath` and before `build`. |
| | `derivedDataDir` | text | empty | `IOS_SIM_DERIVED_DATA_DIR` | Empty uses `<data dir>/DerivedData/<project fingerprint>`. |
| | `disableCodeSigning` | switch | on | `IOS_SIM_DISABLE_CO

plugins.readme_text:
# persona-driven · Persona-Driven Engine (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

> Turns "the AI is too cautious, re-tests every tiny change, burns tokens" into
> **eight adjustable dials**. One sentence — "be decisive" — switches the profile.
> This repository is the **native DeepSeek Harness port** of the `persona-driven` skill:
> a bundled skill, per-turn injection and a hard safety floor, all on native Cordis
> extension points. **No Git Bash, and no per-turn Python subprocess.**

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Install & verify](docs/安装与验收.md) · [Architecture & porting notes](docs/架构与移植说明.md) · [Release & distribution](docs/发布与分发.md)

[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

---

## In 30 seconds

You do not need to know MBTI. MBTI is just a memorable handle; the dial values are what
actually take effect.

| You want | Just say |
|---|---|
| Go faster, stop over-testing | "be decisive", "stop re-testing everything", "too many tokens" |
| Name a type | "use ENTJ", "switch to ESFP" |
| Use a preset | "Fast mode", "use the steady one", "give me a few options" |
| Inspect / turn off | "what persona am I on", "turn off persona" |
| See your data | "persona dashboard" |

Eight dials, each 1–5:

| Group | Dial | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| Execution | PACE | how often to stop and ask |
| Execution | **VERIFY** | **how much verification this change gets** |
| Execution | RISK | how much uncertainty is acceptable |
| Execution | STRUCT | whether existing structure may move |
| Cognition | DETAIL | how much detail to give |
| Cognition | EXPLORE | how many options to offer |
| Interaction | STYLE | how to talk |
| Interaction | WARMTH | attend to the person or the task first |

Four presets — **Fast** (`P5/V4/R4/S4/D5/E1/ST3/W2`), **Steady**, **Explore**, **Companion** —
plus all 16 types. Eight domains (coding, UI design, visual image, finance, writing,
planning, collaboration, decision) each have a dial→output mapping; only the relevant one loads.

---

## Two floors that never come down

**Safety floor.** Deleting/overwriting, payments, auth and permissions, secrets and
credentials, production changes, destructive database statements, irreversible actions —
the profile always reverts to high verification and asks first. Once this plugin is
installed, that becomes a **real** approval prompt via `tools/pre-execute`
(not just the model's good intentions).

**Verification floor.** The profile tunes how much *extra* verification happens, never
*whether* anything is verified. Whatever you change gets verified; introducing new behaviour
or fixing a defect requires fixed, re-runnable evidence, self-reported on the last line.
It is **decoupled** from `EXPLORE` and `PACE` — "only one option" and "just be quick" are
never reasons to verify less.

> **Savings may only come from getting it right the first time**, never from doing less.
> A rework is treated as a signal that earlier verification was under-funded: catch up,
> do not keep skipping.

---

## Install

### Fastest — one command from GitHub (L3, recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yxdotnet/dsh-persona-driven
```

That single command installs the package **and** writes `@dsh-external/persona-driven`
into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; restart DSH and it is live. The same spec can be
pasted into the **Plugins** page in DSH's Web sidebar.

> Measured: pnpm finishes in 9.1 s; `dsh <profile> --dump-config` shows
> `- id: persona-driven` with zero warnings. Once published to npm, the equivalent is
> `add @dsh-external/persona-driven`.

> **No hooks to install.** On DSH the three capabilities — per-turn injection, safety-floor
> interception and telemetry — are carried by the plugin itself (native Cordis extension
> points). Once the plugin is installed there is **no hooks config file and no per-turn
> subprocess**; `~/.dsh/persona/` only ever contains `metrics/` and `sessions/`.
>
> It is the **plugin (Option B)**, not the **skill (Option A)**, that provides L3 — copying
> the skill directory alone gives you no injection and no guard.
> Option C below exists only to keep older configs working — **not recommended**, ignore it
> for a fresh install.

### Option A — skill only (simplest, L1/L2)

Copy `skills/persona-driven/` into a DSH skill root; DSH discovers it automatically.

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell ($env:DSH_HOME defaults to ~/.dsh)
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force .\skills\persona-driven "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\persona-driven"
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills && cp -r skills/persona-driven ~/.dsh/skills/
```

DSH skill roots, lowest rank wins:

| Rank | Path | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` | project |
| 200 | `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills` | project |
| 300 | `customSkillDirs` from the composition | configured |
| 400 | `$DSH_HOME/skills` | user |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | user |
| 600 | bundled skill dir / `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | installation |

`<projectRoot>` is the nearest ancestor containing `.git`.

**This level can influence, not constrain**: tone, detail and pace follow the profile,
but test depth is not enforced and the safety floor does not force a human confirmation.

### Option B — install the plugin (L3, recommended)

The plugin registers the skill, injects the dial block every turn, and turns the safety
floor into a real approval prompt.

```powershell
# add it to a profile (<profile> is desktop / web / tui / ...;
# replace <path-to-this-repo> with where you cloned it)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path-to-this-repo>

# then restart DSH — no hand-editing of the bundle list; the command above does it
```

The command rewrites `dsh.profile.bundles` to include:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@dsh-external/persona-driven"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

You can also install it from DSH's plugin panel (`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`,
with this directory's absolute path as `target`).

> Plugins are modules DSH loads **at startup**; restart DSH for changes to take effect.

### Option C — the hook bridge (**not recommended**; kept for older configs only)

A compatibility path: generate a Claude Code-format `hooks.json` and let DSH's bundled
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge run it.

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks                        # preview, writes nothing
python scripts/persona.py install-hooks --apply --write-confirmed
```

Then add the YAML the script prints into `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (or the profile's own)
and restart DSH:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona-driven-hooks
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
      config:
        configPath: <the hooks.json path printed above>
```

**Pick one of A / B / C.** Options B and C both inject every turn; enabling both injects the
dial block twice (same content, pure token waste).

---

## Verify it actually works

```powershell
cd <path-to-this-repo>
npm test        # 247 assertions + install self-check (84 need a DSH node_modules; that suite reports "skipped, unverified" without one)
npm run doctor  # install self-check only
```

`npm run doctor` reports four things: package and patch integrity, skill payload
completeness, **whether the bundle is installed into any profile**, and whether the state
directory is writable. The criterion is "installed", not "the command exited 0".

Skill-side checks:

```bash
cd skills/persona-driven
python scripts/persona.py doctor   # environment + DSH plugin + optional hook bridge
python scripts/persona.py get      # the effective profile and which layer it came from
```

---

## What this plugin changes vs the WorkBuddy original

| | WorkBuddy | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Injection channel | hook command (`UserPromptSubmit`) | `agent/pre-step` waterfall (native, no subprocess) |
| Dependencies | **Git Bash + Python** | **none** (Python only for the CLI) |
| Safety floor | `Pr

Instead of generating static walls of text, the model writes markdown embedded with interactive component tags, reactive expressions, and beautiful Mermaid diagrams. The chat interface renders them in-place in real time as the response streams in. --- ## 📸 Screenshots | 🧮 Interactive Cost Simulator | ⚖️ Interactive Tech Stack Comparison | | :---: | :---: | | | |

🎨 Themed Mermaid Diagrams with Rounded Nodes & Semantic Role Colors

Form state stays strictly within your local browser session. --- ## 🚀 Installation Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** or later (Desktop app or `dsh web`). ### Option 1: Web UI / Desktop App (Easiest) 1. The model writes standard Markdown enhanced with JSX-like component tags and reactive state declarations: ```md {@body const [seats, setSeats] = useState(25)} {@body const [price, setPrice] = useState(1200)} Team Plan Estimator ``` ### Supported Components & Syntax | Category | Available Elements | |---|---| | **Layout & Structure** | ``, ``, ``, ``, `` | | **Typography & Data** | ``, `<text>`, `<caption>`, `<label>`, `<badge>`, `<icon>`, `<stat>`, `<progress>` | | **Tables & Collections**| `<table>`, `<table-row>`, `<table-cell>` | | **Data Visualization** | `<chart type="bar|line|pie|area" data={...}/>`, Themed Mermaid diagrams | | **Interactive Controls**| `<slider>`, `<input>`, `<checkbox>`, `<radio-group>`, `<radio>`, `<segmented-control>`, `<select>`, `<button>` | | **Expressions & Logic** | `{expression}`, `{#if condition}...{/if}`, `{#each item in list}...{/each}`, `{@body ...}` | --- ## 🛡️ Security & Privacy - **Sandboxed Execution**: Expressions are evaluated via a safe AST interpreter. Values are never sent to the model until you explicitly click an action button. - **Safe Resources**: External links open via DeepSeek Harness's native safe URL handler. External images only load from model-specified HTTPS URLs. --- ## 📋 Compatibility - **DeepSeek Harness**: `v0.2.0-rc.1` or later - **Tested Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet / 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o / GPT-6.1, DeepSeek-V3 / R1 --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webp-relabel

Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as PNG, so local OpenAI-compatible
vision servers accept them.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## The problem

You paste a screenshot into DeepSeek Harness, pick a local vision model, and the
request dies with:

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

The image is fine. The **label** is not.

## Why it happens

DSH normalizes attachments before storing them, and `dsh-attachment-local` picks
the container from the alpha channel:

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

Screenshots have an alpha channel, so they are stored as WebP. The request-image
ladder only ever emits `alpha:webp` or `opaque:jpeg` — there is no PNG rung and no
configuration option for this.

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` then builds the OpenAI `image_url` payload straight from the
prepared request image:

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

so the wire payload becomes `data:image/webp;base64,...`. LM Studio / llama.cpp
validate that label against a PNG/JPEG allowlist and reject the whole call —
even though the bytes decode perfectly well.

## How it works

Wrap `attachments.readImageRequest()` and return **the same bytes** under a
compatible label:

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

Measured against LM Studio with `test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`:

| Payload | Result |
|---------|--------|
| webp bytes + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp bytes + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**, image correctly understood |
| png bytes + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png bytes + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

Only the label is validated, so no image transcoding is needed.
`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` confirms the model really sees the image:
it reads a word drawn into a WebP image sent as `image/png`.

Three implementation details matter, and each was verified rather than assumed:

- **Why not rewrite the request messages?** The adapter takes the label from
  `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`, not from the message's
  `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`. Rewriting messages changes nothing.
- **Why is a service patch picked up immediately?** The adapter resolves the
  service per call (`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`), so
  wrapping the method affects the very next request — no restart, no new session.
- **Why the prototype instead of the instance?** `ctx.get()` returns a Cordis
  "traceable" `Proxy` whose `set` trap routes through an extra shadow receiver, so
  an instance-level write is not reliably observable. A property on the prototype
  is always found by the proxy's own descriptor walk.

The model-visible attachment handle text is unaffected: it is built from
`ref.mediaType`, not `version.mediaType`, so it still describes the stored WebP
accurately.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz
```

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-webp-relabel
```

### From a local checkout (verified)

Point the plugin manager at the directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-webp-relabel
```

The package is then registered as a link dependency, and its own
`cordis.patch.yml` supplies the loader row — so installing the bundle is the only
step. (Observed on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`: `install_bundle` does **not** insert a row
by itself, which is why this bundle ships its own.)

Installing entirely by hand instead? Add the row to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

## Configuration

The bundle already applies these defaults; add this block to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` only to override them:

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # label to replace (default)
    to: image/png        # replacement label (default)
    debug: true          # log one line per relabeled image (default)
```

## Verify it works

With `debug: true` the DSH console prints one line per relabeled image:

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png (1200x800px, 84521B, ref sha256:...)
```

You can also check the model server's own request log: the payload should contain
`"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."` rather than `image/webp`.

## Disable / uninstall

Disable the plugin in the DSH plugin manager, or set `to: image/webp` in the
config. Either way the original `readImageRequest` is restored from the saved
descriptor — the patch is fully reversible.

## Limitations

- **The label does not match the container.** The bytes stay WebP while the label
  says PNG. This is correct for servers that validate the label (LM Studio,
  llama.cpp). A provider that strictly validates magic bytes would still reject
  it, and the right fix there is real transcoding (`sharp`, `sips`) rather than
  relabeling.
- **It applies to every provider,** because `readImageRequest()` cannot see which
  route the call is going to. Scoping it to local routes would need an extra
  `llm/stream` listener keyed by `options.provider`.
- **It depends on DSH internals:** the `attachments` service, its
  `readImageRequest` method, and that method being a class method on the
  prototype. If a DSH upgrade breaks it, those are the two things to check.

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

Seven cases in `test/plugin-patch.test.mjs`, covering the relabel itself, that the
patch survives a Cordis-style traceable `Proxy`, that non-WebP labels pass
through untouched, that disposing restores the original method (including when it
is inherited from a base class), configurable targets, and idempotent re-apply.

`test/diagnostics/` holds the server-side probes described above.

---

## 简体中文

把 DSH 归一化出来的 WebP 请求图片**重标记为 PNG**，让本地 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型愿意收下它。

### 问题

在聊天窗口粘贴截图、选一个本地视觉模型，请求直接失败：

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

图片本身没问题，**标签**不对。

### 原因

`dsh-attachment-local` 归一化时按 alpha 通道选容器：

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

截图带 alpha，于是被存成 WebP；请求图档（ladder）只有 `alpha:webp` 和
`opaque:jpeg` 两级，没有 PNG，也没有对应配置项。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 再把 `version.mediaType` 直接写进 OpenAI 的 `image_url`：

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

于是线上载荷变成 `data:image/webp;base64,...`。LM Studio / llama.cpp 只允许
PNG/JPEG 标签，整条请求被拒——而字节本身完全能解码。

### 做法

包装 `attachments.readImageRequest()`，**字节一个不改**，只换标签：

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

实测（`test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`，LM Studio）：

| 载荷 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| webp 字节 + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp 字节 + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**，图片被正确理解 |
| png 字节 + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png 字节 + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

即**只校验标签**，所以不需要真的转码。`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` 进一步确认模型
是"真看见了"：让它读一张以 `image/png` 名义发出的 WebP 图上的字，能读对。

三个关键点都是核实过的，不是推测：

- **为什么不改请求消息？** 适配器的标签来自 `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`，
  不是消息块的 `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`，改消息没有任何作用。
- **为什么打补丁立刻生效？** 适配器每次请求都重新解析服务
  （`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`），所以下一次请求就走新方法，
  不用重启、不用新会话。
- **为什么打在原型而不是实例上？** `ctx.get()` 返回 Cordis 的 "traceable" `Proxy`，
  实例级写入会被 shadow receiver 吞掉；原型属性一定会被 Proxy 的描述符查找命中。

模型可见的图片句柄文案不受影响：它取自 `ref.mediaType` 而不是 `version.mediaType`，
所以仍然准确描述存储的 WebP。

### 安装

本地目录（已实测）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/绝对路径/dsh-webp-relabel
```

手工安装则在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

### 配置（可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # 被替换的标签
    to: image/png        # 替换成的标签
    debug: true          # 每张图打印一行日志
```

### 验证

`debug: true` 时 DSH 控制台会打印：

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png

plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leafy-skin

An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Compatibility

| Plugin version | DSH version |
| --- | --- |
| v0.1.1 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |
| v0.1.0 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |

## Screenshot

![Screenshot](show.png)

## Features

- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

## Usage

Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

## Customize

- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, text and syntax
  contrast, and the style layer's three constraints.

## Uninstall

Any one of these, then restart DSH:

1. Comment out the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. Drop `dsh-leafy-skin` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`;
3. Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-leafy-skin`.

## Known limitations

- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Contributing

Questions and suggestions are welcome as issues. Pull requests are not accepted.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
